I sat down with Parker J. Smith, a 25-year-old entrepreneur who went from driving DoorDash to generating $81,000 in monthly revenue from a water filtration business he launched just 85 days earlier. We break down how he started with around $500, uses licensed plumbers to handle the installations, and finds customers through simple Facebook ads that show the price upfront. Parker also shares his costs, margins, tech stack, follow-up strategy, and why overlooked home service businesses may offer more opportunity than crowded online businesses.
